_help: Racing wheels New-RealWheelArt can show on the main menu. key: cache name. match: pieces of the name Windows reports (case-insensitive). usb: VID:PID. ghub: Logitech G HUB picture folder (used first when G HUB is installed). image: the maker's front-view picture, downloaded once into C:\ProgramData\ArcadeMaster\wheels on the cabinet that has the wheel - never into the repo.
